items.original: He said to me, "You are right."
a: He told me that I was right.

items.original: She said, "I will go home tomorrow."
a: She said that she would go home the next day.
She said that she would go home the following day.

items.original: The boy said, "I have done my work."
a: The boy said that he had done his work.

items.original: He said to her, "What are you doing?"
a: He asked her what she was doing.
items.rule_bn: Wh-প্রশ্ন: asked + Wh; are you doing→she was doing।

items.original: Mother said to me, "Do not go out."
a: Mother forbade me to go out.
Mother told me not to go out.
items.rule_bn: নিষেধ: forbade to / told not to।

items.original: He said, "I can help you now."
a: He said that he could help me then.

items.original: She said to him, "Please wait here."
a: She requested him to wait there.
He said that he had to leave then.
